verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's self-hosted, single-binary model (docs-11/19) implies fixed infra costs rather than per-request billing, but hands-on reports directly contradict predictable costs: one team found RAM usage 'impossible to plan' since heavy query traffic caused unpredictable, expensive resource consumption (meilisearch-comm-3), and another reviewer flagged the Cloud plan jumping abruptly from a free tier to $1200/month with no smooth scaling (meilisearch-comm-2). Missing for 10: any official pricing/cost-predictability documentation, usage-based billing details, or evidence refuting the RAM/cost unpredictability reports.
